(module asl-compiler/wasiIoTest                                                                                            :x [testEncodeCiovec testWasiFileRoundtrip testWasiNonExistentFileHandling testWasiPathOpenOflags testWasiFdWriteValidation testWasiDirListAndStat runTests] :i [(wasi :a wasi)])

fn testEncodeCiovec -> Bool
  (let [(vec (wasi/encodeCiovec 65536 10))] (assert (= (listLength vec) 8) "encodeCiovec must produce strictly 8 bytes") (refute (!= (listLength vec) 8) "Vector byte length must not deviate from 8") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 0) -1) 0) "Pointer byte 0 must be 0") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 1) -1) 0) "Pointer byte 1 must be 0") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 2) -1) 1) "Pointer byte 2 must be 1 (65536 = 0x00010000)") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 3) -1) 0) "Pointer byte 3 must be 0") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 4) -1) 10) "Length byte 0 must be 10") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 5) -1) 0) "Length byte 1 must be 0") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 6) -1) 0) "Length byte 2 must be 0") (assert (= (optionOr (listGet vec 7) -1) 0) "Length byte 3 must be 0") (let [(vecZero (wasi/encodeCiovec 0 0))] (assert (= (listLength vecZero) 8) "Zero vector must also be 8 bytes") (refute (!= (listLength vecZero) 8) "Zero vector length must be 8")) true)

fn testWasiFileRoundtrip -> Bool
  (let [(dirRes (dirCreate "tmp")) (path "tmp/wasi_roundtrip.txt") (content "Hello WASI Sovereign Filesystem Roundtrip 42\n") (writeRes (wasi/wasiFileWrite path content))] (assert (ok? dirRes) "dirCreate must succeed for scratch directory") (assert (ok? writeRes) (str "wasiFileWrite must succeed, got: " (optionOr (mt writeRes ((err e) (some e)) ((ok _) (none))) ""))) (refute (not (ok? writeRes)) "wasiFileWrite must not return error") (assert (wasi/wasiFileExists? path) "Written file must exist") (let [(readRes (wasi/wasiFileRead path))] (mt readRes ((ok text) (do (assert (= text content) "Read content must match written content") (refute (!= text content) "Read content must not diverge") (let [(rmRes (pathRemove path))] (assert (ok? rmRes) "pathRemove must remove written roundtrip file") (refute (wasi/wasiFileExists? path) "Removed roundtrip file must not exist")) true)) ((err _) false))))

fn testWasiNonExistentFileHandling -> Bool
  (let [(missingPath "tmp/non_existent_file_987654.txt")] (assert (not (wasi/wasiFileExists? missingPath)) "Missing path must not exist") (refute (wasi/wasiFileExists? missingPath) "wasiFileExists? must return false for missing path") (let [(readRes (wasi/wasiFileRead missingPath))] (mt readRes ((ok _) false) ((err code) (do (assert (= code "ENOENT") "Error code must be ENOENT") (refute (= code "ESUCCESS") "Error code must not be ESUCCESS") true))))))

fn testWasiPathOpenOflags -> Bool
  (let [(missingPath "tmp/open_missing_test_123.txt") (openNoCreat (wasi/wasiPathOpen 3 missingPath 0))] (assert (err? openNoCreat) "Opening missing path without O_CREAT must fail") (refute (ok? openNoCreat) "Opening missing path without O_CREAT must not succeed") (mt openNoCreat ((ok _) false) ((err code) (assert (= code "ENOENT") "Failure code must be ENOENT"))) (let [(invalidDirFd (wasi/wasiPathOpen 1 "some_path.txt" 0))] (assert (err? invalidDirFd) "Opening with stdout fd must return error") (refute (ok? invalidDirFd) "Opening with stdout fd must not succeed") (mt invalidDirFd ((ok _) false) ((err code) (assert (= code "EBADF") "Invalid dir fd must report EBADF")))) true)

fn testWasiFdWriteValidation -> Bool
  (let [(resNeg (wasi/wasiFdWrite -1 "hello")) (resStdin (wasi/wasiFdWrite 0 "hello")) (resClosed (wasi/wasiFdWrite 99 "hello")) (resStdout (wasi/wasiFdWrite 1 "test stdout\n"))] (assert (err? resNeg) "Writing to negative fd must fail") (refute (ok? resNeg) "Negative fd must not succeed") (assert (err? resStdin) "Writing to stdin fd must fail") (refute (ok? resStdin) "Stdin fd must not succeed for write") (assert (err? resClosed) "Writing to invalid fd 99 must fail") (refute (ok? resClosed) "Invalid fd must not succeed") (assert (ok? resStdout) "Writing to stdout fd must succeed") (refute (not (ok? resStdout)) "Stdout write must not fail") true)

fn testWasiDirListAndStat -> Bool
  (let [(entries (wasi/wasiDirList "asl/packages/asl-compiler/src"))] (assert (not (listEmpty? entries)) "Source directory must contain entries") (refute (listEmpty? entries) "Source directory entry list must not be empty") (let [(stOpt (wasi/wasiFileStat "asl/packages/asl-compiler/src/wasi.asl"))] (mt stOpt ((some st) (do (assert (= (optionOr (mapGet st "filetype") -1) 4) "wasi.asl must have filetype REGULAR_FILE (4)") (refute (= (optionOr (mapGet st "filetype") -1) 3) "wasi.asl must not be a directory") (assert (> (optionOr (mapGet st "size") -1) 0) "wasi.asl size must be greater than 0") true)) ((none) false))))

fn testWasiFdTableLifecycle -> Bool
  (let [(dirRes (dirCreate "tmp")) (filePath "tmp/wasi_fd_lifecycle.txt") (openRes (wasi/wasiPathOpen 3 filePath 1))] (assert (ok? dirRes) "dirCreate must succeed for scratch directory") (assert (ok? openRes) "wasiPathOpen with O_CREAT must succeed") (refute (not (ok? openRes)) "wasiPathOpen must not fail") (mt openRes ((ok fd) (do (assert (>= fd 4) "Allocated file descriptor must be >= 4") (refute (< fd 4) "Allocated descriptor must not collide with standard descriptors") (let [(wRes (wasi/wasiFdWrite fd "Dynamic FD Table Data\n"))] (assert (ok? wRes) "wasiFdWrite must succeed on open descriptor") (refute (not (ok? wRes)) "wasiFdWrite must not fail") (let [(closeRes (wasi/wasiFdClose fd))] (assert (ok? closeRes) "wasiFdClose must succeed on open descriptor") (refute (not (ok? closeRes)) "wasiFdClose must not fail") (let [(postCloseWrite (wasi/wasiFdWrite fd "after close")) (postCloseClose (wasi/wasiFdClose fd))] (assert (err? postCloseWrite) "wasiFdWrite must reject closed descriptor") (refute (ok? postCloseWrite) "Closed descriptor must not permit writes") (assert (err? postCloseClose) "wasiFdClose must reject already closed descriptor") (refute (ok? postCloseClose) "Already closed descriptor must not close twice") (let [(rmFile (pathRemove filePath))] (assert (ok? rmFile) "pathRemove must remove lifecycle test file") (refute (wasi/wasiFileExists? filePath) "Lifecycle test file must not exist")) true)))))) ((err _) false)))

fn runTests -> Bool
  (do (let [(scratchRes (dirCreate "tmp"))] (assert (ok? scratchRes) "dirCreate must create tmp scratch directory")) (assert (testEncodeCiovec) "testEncodeCiovec must pass") (assert (testWasiFileRoundtrip) "testWasiFileRoundtrip must pass") (assert (testWasiNonExistentFileHandling) "testWasiNonExistentFileHandling must pass") (assert (testWasiPathOpenOflags) "testWasiPathOpenOflags must pass") (assert (testWasiFdWriteValidation) "testWasiFdWriteValidation must pass") (assert (testWasiDirListAndStat) "testWasiDirListAndStat must pass") (assert (testWasiFdTableLifecycle) "testWasiFdTableLifecycle must pass") (if (fileExists? "tmp/.asl_wasi_fd_table") (let [(rmTable (pathRemove "tmp/.asl_wasi_fd_table"))] (assert (ok? rmTable) "pathRemove must remove fd table")) true) (let [(rmDir (pathRemove "tmp"))] (assert (ok? rmDir) "pathRemove must remove scratch directory")) true)
